_readme: gADR-0014. The tracer's search_download acquire fetches a preconfigured, license-verified 'url' per asset (below) rather than driving a live open-asset search over the rendered query — a live search API is a follow-up; the fixed candidate keeps the demo reproducible.

category_licenses._readme: Per-category download-license extensions on top of the global CC0/CC-BY rule (gADR-0014/GDD). Fonts additionally allow OFL — a permissive FONT license — so a downloaded OFL pixel font is accepted for fonts only; every other category stays CC0/CC-BY (P2-S9, #445).

lifecycle._readme: gADR-0015. lfs_size_threshold_bytes is T: an assets/** file at/over it must be Git-LFS-tracked, uniform across categories (never per-category). Revisable spec-data; the gate is tools/assets/lifecycle.py and .gitattributes is its mechanical consequence.

player._note: P2-S5 (#443): the Player animated sprite SET. Its committed form is the derived SpriteFrames recorded under manifest id 'player' (gADR-0016, Model S); the per-state sheets player_<state>.png are its backing. Landed as REAL Gemini-generated art (Nano Banana Pro, one animation strip per state: idle/run/jump/fire/hurt/consume/level_up/death), recorded under generation terms; this recipe is retained to re-generate the set.

hud_font._note: P2-S9 (#445): the HUD bitmap font. Its committed form is the derived AngelCode .fnt recorded under manifest id 'hud_font'; the search_download acquire fetches the OFL pixel-font TTF below, which tools/assets/hud_font_build.py rasterizes into the glyph sheet and derives. No scale_key — the font's native size is the Scale spec's hud_font_size (gADR-0013), read by the font build, not a 2-D box.
